title: Typed join predicates are copied across unequal key types

primary_commit.author: Pavel Velikhov
primary_commit.subject: [NEW RBO] Push constant condition on join key to both sides (#46050)

related_commits.author: Pavel Velikhov
related_commits.subject: [NEW OPTIMIZER] Fix bugs in join filter processing (#49829)
related_commits.role: same assumption added to simple-join-filter rule

evidence: The commit adds cross-side predicate copying through ApplyRenames without checking source/target key type equivalence. Parent lacks this block. The sibling rule later copies the same assumption. SSA migration changes representation, not the missing proof.

title: Volatile filters change aggregate values
evidence: Introduces the filter-through-aggregate rule. Applicability checks unresolved subplans and key dependencies, but no volatility/evaluation-multiplicity restriction.

title: DISTINCT aggregates over grouping sets compute incorrect subtotals

related_commits.author: Denis Khalikov
related_commits.subject: [Optimizer] Add distinct aggregation expander. (#42994)
related_commits.role: preexisting DISTINCT expansion involved in the interaction

evidence: Moves rollup/grouping-set expansion from frontend per-branch aggregation into the postorder rule stage containing DISTINCT expansion. The child DISTINCT now expands before grouping-set fanout. Prior frontend placement handled distinct at each grouping branch.

title: Filter fusion evaluates expressions on rows already rejected
evidence: The new fuse_filters rule constructs conjuncts from the top filter first and appends bottom-filter conjuncts. The reversed evaluation order is present at rule introduction; later cached-expression and SSA edits preserve it.

title: Scalar subquery validation runs for unrelated correlation keys

primary_commit.author: Denis Khalikov
primary_commit.subject: [Optimizer] Add initial support for decorrelation based Neumann work. (#51876)

evidence: The initial dependent-join implementation removes the demanded domain when all correlations bind to inner columns. The same change adds scalar per-group cardinality checks, allowing checks on unrelated inner domains.

title: Correlation can select the wrong row after a key type changes

primary_commit.author: Denis Khalikov
primary_commit.subject: [Optimizer] Add initial support for decorrelation based Neumann work. (#51876)

evidence: Introduces capture rebinding directly to an inner column without preserving the captured type, alongside StablePickle-based nullable-domain encoding. The complete mechanism precedes SSA migration.

title: Domain elimination admits matches forbidden by NaN equality

primary_commit.author: Denis Khalikov
primary_commit.subject: [Optimizer] Add initial support for decorrelation based Neumann work. (#51876)

evidence: Introduces elimination of the correlation equality after recording a binding. It restores only nullable-column existence checks, with no nonreflexive floating-point equality guard.

title: Empty correlated scalar aggregates skip their result expression

primary_commit.author: Denis Khalikov
primary_commit.subject: [Optimizer] Add initial support for decorrelation based Neumann work. (#51876)

evidence: Initial aggregate decorrelation restores missing domain rows only when countResults is nonempty. The count-only restoration guard already exists in this initial implementation.

title: IN subqueries ignore the requested NULL-semantics mode

primary_commit.author: Denis Khalikov
primary_commit.subject: [Optimizer] Add initial support for decorrelation based Neumann work. (#51876)

evidence: Exact observed legacy-mode failure combines a producer that omits IN policy with the later generic lowering that explicitly synthesizes ANSI three-valued results. No single introducing author is established for the complete symptom.

title: Nullable NaN is mistaken for NULL in IN handling

primary_commit.author: Denis Khalikov
primary_commit.subject: [Optimizer] Add initial support for decorrelation based Neumann work. (#51876)

evidence: Adds the nullable lookup null-test using negated self-equality. The parent generic lowering lacks this test; NaN is included by the new null-detection expression.

title: IN typing removes a necessary COALESCE fallback

primary_commit.author: Pavel Velikhov
primary_commit.subject: [NEW RBO] Support uncorrelated simple IN and EXISTS predicates (#31204)

related_commits.author: Denis Khalikov
related_commits.subject: [Optimizer] Add initial support for decorrelation based Neumann work. (#51876)
related_commits.role: adds explicit nullable three-valued IN result production

evidence: Introduces plain Bool annotations for IN at both frontend sublink and RBO subplan levels. Later nullable mark-result lowering exposes the mismatch to COALESCE simplification. Attribute both sides of the type contract, not only the old Bool line.

title: Hidden grouping columns prevent DISTINCT from removing duplicates

primary_commit.author: Denis Khalikov
primary_commit.subject: [KQP RBO] Add multiple aggregations in expressions (#29314)

related_commits.author: Denis Khalikov
related_commits.subject: [Optimizer] Fix distinct on top of aggregation (#41846)
related_commits.role: later duplicate-key cleanup preserves hidden-key inclusion

evidence: Adds all aggregation grouping keys to post-aggregate DISTINCT, including keys absent from the projected result. Later duplicate-key cleanup leaves that semantic inclusion intact.

title: Grouped result expressions are replaced by a bare grouping key

primary_commit.author: Denis Khalikov
primary_commit.subject: [NEW RBO] Refactor to support YqlSelect Aggregation (#30538)

related_commits.author: Denis Khalikov
related_commits.subject: [KQP RBO] Add multiple aggregations in expressions (#29314)

related_commits.author: Denis Khalikov
related_commits.subject: [Optimizer] Fix order by groupby ref. (#52969)
related_commits.role: partial repair that retains the materialized-case defect

evidence: Extends the whole-expression replacement on any nested group reference to native YQL aggregates. The earlier PG-oriented implementation already had the pattern. The later group-reference fix repairs nonmaterialized expressions but leaves the materialized case.

title: Aggregates on different nested fields share the wrong input

related_commits.author: Denis Khalikov
related_commits.subject: [Optimizer] Emit more optimal code for scalar aggregation. (#41727)
related_commits.role: removes forceOptional bypass that previously avoided some scalar collisions

evidence: Replaces fresh names for repeated aggregation inputs with reuse keyed only by member name. Parent generated a fresh column on name collision; this change skips a second preaggregation expression when its leaf name matches. Later scalar optional-state cleanup widens exposure.

title: A scalar subquery is evaluated outside its conditional guard

primary_commit.author: Pavel Velikhov
primary_commit.subject: [NEW RBO] Added support for scalar context (#28107)

related_commits.author: Denis Khalikov
related_commits.subject: [Optimizer] Add initial support for decorrelation based Neumann work. (#51876)
related_commits.role: current per-group Ensure reimplementation preserves unconditional attachment

evidence: Initial scalar-context lowering attaches a cardinality-checked subplan by cross join before the containing unary expression, without retaining its conditional guard. Current per-group Ensure lowering reimplements this architecture. Historic source proves the hoisting pattern, but the exact first failing modern-YQL query has not been bisected.

title: Unresolved subqueries enter block-cross join filters too early

primary_commit.author: Denis Khalikov
primary_commit.subject: [Optimizer] Add support for cross join with filters (#52096)

evidence: Adds the block-cross fast path that moves every non-equality conjunct into JoinFilters without excluding unresolved subplans. A later force-inlining flag condition narrows when this block runs; it does not create the missing subplan guard.
